title: observation.v1
description: One measured fact about a device at one instant. Published on telemetry.raw.<source> (source-specific metric names) and telemetry.normalized (canonical metric names). The message is delivered at-least-once; observation_id is stable so duplicates are detectable.

observation_id.description: Stable per measurement: derived from collection cycle, device, metric and labels.

correlation_id.description: One per collection cycle; follows every derived artefact.

value.description: Strings are limited to 1024 bytes; numbers must be finite.

observed_at.description: When the device was measured. Not more than 5 minutes in the future.

received_at.description: Set by the first consumer on receipt.
